entities.summary: The Lei Maria da Penha, officially Law No. 11,340 of 7 August 2006, targets gender based violence in Brazil, with the specific aim of reducing domestic violence in the country. Sanctioned on 7 August 2006 by president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and subsequently implemented on 22 September 2006, the law is an important contribution to an international movement of criminalizing violence against women. The law is named after Brazilian activist Maria da Penha Maia, who herself was a victim of domestic violence.
